module: Global orbital camera around a fixed point (fixedTargetPos), used by the rally pacenotes annotation tools. Rotation by mouse, by keys (left/right, forward/backward) or by yaw/pitch inputs; zoom between 10 and 1500 m (300 by default), FOV 65. The camera is kept at least 1 m above the terrain (core_terrain). Returns a constructor.
notes: update resets MoveManager.zoomIn/zoomOut to zero after reading them (so continuous zoom is limited to the frame).
reset tests self.cameraResetted == 0 whereas this field is never defined in this file (nil): the function does nothing (dead code); camLastTargetPos2 neither.
onSettingsChanged calls core_camera.clearInputs() (code comment: "is this really necessary?").

C.desc: Orbit around a point. Fields: fixedTargetPos, fov, camRot (vec3 degrees: x yaw, y pitch), camDist, defaultDistance, camMinDist, camMaxDist.

init.desc: isGlobal = true, FOV 65, then setupStuff, onSettingsChanged, reset.

setupStuff.desc: Sets default rotation (0, -17, 0), distance limits 10-1500 m and default distance 300 m.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook: re-reads the cameraOrbit* settings (fovModifier, relaxation, maxDynamicFov, maxDynamicPitch, maxDynamicOffset, smoothing).

setRef.desc: Sets the point to orbit around; only center is used.

setDefaultDistance.desc: Changes defaultDistance (without modifying the current distance camDist).

update.desc: Computes the orbital position, clips it to the terrain and writes data.res (collisionCompatible = true).
